label_protocol: experiments use exactly-one-positive rows only; single-label; closed world over MAIN classes
no_eval_tuning: evaluation set is never used for model selection or hyperparameters
hybrid_hyperparams: hybrid blend weight and temperature fixed in advance or selected on support set only
metrics: per-class recall (always reported together with per-class evaluation counts)
support_sampling: per seed: numpy random.default_rng(seed), classes in sorted order; support = first k images of one fixed permutation (nested across shots)
cache_policy: embeddings cached for ALL images that have both a label row and an image file, label-agnostic (expected 856); class filtering happens at experiment time; stems matched globally across split folders
